title: Notification regarding regular sitting of division and single bench constitute w.e.f. 01.07.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Division Benches and Single Benches as per the following table w.e.f. 01.07.2026, until further

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 23rd June, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : it is hereby informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that Hon’ble The Chief Justice is pleased to constitute the regular sitting of the
Division Benches and Single Benches as per the following table w.e.f. 01.07.2026, until further
order(s)
SINGLE BENCHDIVISION BENCH
Hon'ble The Chief Justice 1. Hon’ble The Chief Justice
2. HMJ A. Birnol Singh
3. HMJ A. Guneshwar Sharma
with
HMJ A. Guneshwar Sharma
e Every Friday, Division Bench shall be of Hon'ble The Chief Justice and Hon'ble Mr. Justice
A. Bimol Singh. If Friday falls on a holiday, Hon'ble The Chief Justice will sit in a Division
Bench with Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh on the last working day of that week.
This issues in supersession of all earlier notifications in this regard.•
As regards subject for the’benches, notification bearing No, HCM/1/96-BENCH/12845-62
dated 27th May, 2026 which is now operating, will continue until further order of Hon’bre
The Chief Justice.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(KH. AIIT SINGH)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
